#!/usr/bin/env bash
# --mem-size contract: one model-neutral flag, per-model semantics.
#
#   fast:   forwards a plain `-m` only when given (QEMU as-is otherwise);
#           QEMU itself validates the 2 GiB AE350 DRAM window.
#   hybrid: sizes the shared mmap (= QEMU backend = vsim window); the driver
#           caps at 2G BEFORE allocating the backing file.
#   cycle:  validate-only (the engine always models its full DRAM window).
#   --mmap-size stays as a hidden alias of --mem-size.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
ELF="$ROOT/tests/fixtures/vplat_hello.elf"        # engine-portable (fast/cycle)
MELF="$ROOT/tests/fixtures/rt_c_hello.elf"        # carries ROI markers (hybrid)

bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "missing executable: $BIN"
[ -f "$ELF" ] || fail "missing fixture: $ELF (make -C tests/fixtures)"
[ -f "$MELF" ] || fail "missing fixture: $MELF (make -C tests/fixtures)"

# 1. fast + --mem-size 1G: forwarded -m accepted, program still runs.
out=$("$BIN" run --mode fast --mem-size 1G "$ELF" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "fast --mem-size 1G rc=$rc:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "hello from vplat" \
  || fail "fast --mem-size 1G lost program output:"$'\n'"$out"

# 2. fast + --mem-size 4G: QEMU itself rejects (as-is validation).
out=$("$BIN" run --mode fast --mem-size 4G "$ELF" </dev/null 2>&1) \
  && fail "fast --mem-size 4G should fail:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -qi "cannot model more than" \
  || fail "fast 4G failure should be QEMU's own DRAM-window error:"$'\n'"$out"

# 3. fast + a size that is not a whole MiB: driver rejects before spawning.
out=$("$BIN" run --mode fast --mem-size 1000 "$ELF" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 2 ] || fail "fast --mem-size 1000 rc=$rc (want 2):"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "whole MiB" || fail "missing MiB-granularity hint:"$'\n'"$out"

# 4. hybrid + --mem-size 4G: early driver cap, no mmap file allocated.
out=$("$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker --engine vsim:ax45mpv_premium \
        --mem-size 4G "$MELF" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 2 ] || fail "hybrid --mem-size 4G rc=$rc (want 2):"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "AE350 DRAM window" || fail "missing 2G cap message:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "\[hsim mmap\]" \
  && fail "hybrid 4G must fail BEFORE allocating the mmap:"$'\n'"$out"

# 5. hybrid + --mem-size 256M: sized mmap + the run completes.
out=$("$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker --engine vsim:ax45mpv_premium \
        --mem-size 256M "$MELF" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "hybrid --mem-size 256M rc=$rc:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "\[hsim mmap\] 256.0 MiB" \
  || fail "mmap status line should show 256.0 MiB:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "window_cycles" || fail "no cycle figure:"$'\n'"$out"

# 6. the retired --mmap-size spelling still works (hidden alias).
out=$("$BIN" run --mode hybrid --trigger marker --engine vsim:ax45mpv_premium \
        --mmap-size 192M "$MELF" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "--mmap-size alias rc=$rc:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "\[hsim mmap\] 192.0 MiB" \
  || fail "alias should size the mmap to 192.0 MiB:"$'\n'"$out"

# 7. cycle + --mem-size: validated, declared a no-op, run still passes.
out=$("$BIN" run --mode cycle --engine vsim:ax45mpv_premium \
        --mem-size 64M "$ELF" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "cycle --mem-size 64M rc=$rc:"$'\n'"$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q "nothing to size" \
  || fail "cycle should say --mem-size has nothing to size:"$'\n'"$out"

=== tests/lib/log.sh ===
# Shared status printers for test scripts. Sourced (not executed).
#
#   fail <msg...>          -> "[FAIL] <msg>" on stderr, exit 1
#   ok   <msg...>          -> "[ok] <msg>" on stdout
#   expect <rc> <re> CMD.. -> run CMD, fail unless it exits <rc> and its
#                             combined output matches the <re> regex
#
# These patterns were duplicated byte-identically across many test scripts.
# Source via:   . "$SCRIPT_DIR/<rel>/lib/log.sh"

fail() { echo "[FAIL] $*" >&2; exit 1; }
ok()   { echo "[ok] $*"; }

expect() {
  local want="$1" re="$2"; shift 2
  local out rc
  out=$("$@" 2>&1 </dev/null); rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -eq "$want" ] || fail "rc=$rc want $want for [$*]: $out"
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq "$re" || fail "missing /$re/ for [$*]: $out"
}

# Repo root, derived from this lib's own location (tests/lib/ -> ../..).
_LIB_ROOT=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)

# cfg_val KEY -> the value of KEY in the repo-root config.env ("" if absent).
# A lightweight read so a test runs without a prior `source ./setup.sh`.
cfg_val() { grep -oP "$1=\\K.*" "$_LIB_ROOT/config.env" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '"' | head -1; }

# The external vsim build dir (the sim_* binaries), the way the driver resolves
# it: VSIM_BIN_DIR env, then config.env, then the legacy in-tree build dir.
vsim_bin_dir() {
  if [ -n "${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$VSIM_BIN_DIR"; return; fi
  local v; v=$(cfg_val VSIM_BIN_DIR)
  [ -n "$v" ] && printf '%s\n' "$v" || printf '%s\n' "$_LIB_ROOT/verilator/build"
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# --mem-size contract (minimal slice): one model-neutral flag.
#
#   fast:   parse + forward a plain `-m` (QEMU as-is; QEMU validates the size).
#           A malformed size or a non-whole-MiB is rejected in the driver.
#   cycle:  validated, then declared a no-op (the engine models its full DRAM).
#   hybrid: overrides the shared-mmap size (exercised by the hybrid tests).
#   --mmap-size stays a hidden alias of --mem-size.
#
# The tiered backing resolver + the 2 GiB cap land as the feature grows.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"

bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
[ -x "$BIN" ] || fail "missing executable: $BIN"

# 1. fast + a size that is not a whole MiB: driver rejects before spawning.
expect 2 'whole MiB' "$BIN" run --mode fast --mem-size 1000 p.elf
# 2. fast + a malformed size: driver rejects with the argparse-style message.
expect 2 'invalid mmap size' "$BIN" run --mode fast --mem-size 8X p.elf
# 3. the retired --mmap-size spelling is a hidden alias of --mem-size.
expect 2 'whole MiB' "$BIN" run --mode fast --mmap-size 1000 p.elf

# 4. cycle + --mem-size: validated, then declared a no-op. A throwaway fake
#    engine (self-describes as cycle-accurate, echoes when run) keeps this
#    hermetic -- no real vsim needed.
TMP=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
cat >"$TMP/v1" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = "--describe" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' '{"id":"vsim:v1","type":"vsim","kind":"cycle-accurate","roles":["standalone","accurate-leg"],"invoke":{"standalone":["{bin}","{elf}"]}}'
else
  echo "RAN args:$*"
fi
EOF
chmod +x "$TMP/v1"
expect 0 'nothing to size' \
  env ANDESIM_ENGINES_DIR="$TMP" "$BIN" run --mode cycle --mem-size 64M dummy.elf

# 5. fast + --mem-size 256M: the forwarded -m is accepted and the program still
#    runs (guarded on a built qemu + fixture; a missing artifact is a skip).
QDIR="${QEMU_BIN_DIR:-$(cfg_val QEMU_BIN_DIR)}"
QEMU="${VSIM_QEMU:-$QDIR/qemu-system-riscv64}"
ELF="$ROOT/tests/fixtures/rt_c_hello.elf"
if [ -x "$QEMU" ] && [ -f "$ELF" ]; then
  out=$("$BIN" run --mode fast --mem-size 256M "$ELF" </dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || fail "fast --mem-size 256M rc=$rc:"$'\n'"$out"
  echo "$out" | grep -q "hello from QEMU1" \
    || fail "fast --mem-size 256M lost program output:"$'\n'"$out"
  echo "[ok] real fast run with --mem-size 256M"
else
  echo "[skip] real fast --mem-size run: qemu and/or fixture not built ($QEMU / $ELF)"
fi

ok "--mem-size (fast forwards -m, cycle no-op, --mmap-size alias)"
